entwurf.beschreibung: Watch how Claude Code turns your terminal into a coding genie, from install to first command, with humor and real‑world limits. It’s fast, free for a trial, but remember usage caps and subscription tiers. A quick demo, step‑by‑step, keeps you coding before the AI stops you for safety checks.

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Got 10 minutes and a terminal? Claude will make you a coder in that time, or at least pretend to.
teile.szene: A dim office, a laptop open, a coffee mug beside the keyboard. Light from a desk lamp creates a cozy glow. The camera pans from the screen showing the command prompt to the user’s hand typing.

teile.name: Problem
teile.text: Every coder’s nightmare: copy‑paste chaos, endless bugs, and that one file that refuses to load. You wish there was a genie.
teile.szene: A cluttered desk, files stacked, a frustrated coder staring at a blinking cursor. The air smells of burnt coffee. A clock shows 3 am. Light flickers as the screen dims.

teile.name: Tool
teile.text: First, install the CLI: curl https://claude.ai/install.cmd – you’ll run claude --version. If that prints a number, you’re in business.
teile.szene: Terminal window on a black background. The command appears, typed in green, then the prompt changes to show a version number. A satisfied grin forms.

teile.name: Step
teile.text: Type your first prompt: "write a hello world script in Python". Claude writes, runs it, and shows output—no manual save needed.
teile.szene: Screen split: left side shows the prompt, right side shows a freshly created main.py file. The terminal executes, printing Hello World. A checkmark appears.

teile.name: Limit
teile.text: Remember: free tier caps every 5 hours, weekly limits, and a safety classifier stops risky code. Upgrade if you need more firepower.
teile.szene: A calendar with marked 5‑hour intervals, a warning icon, and a price tag of $20/month. The user looks puzzled, then considers upgrading.

teile.name: Call to Action
teile.text: Now it’s your turn—install Claude, write a script, and share your first line of code. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: The screen zooms out to reveal the user clicking a share button, then smiling at the camera.
